title: Hunger to Energy bar
description: Replaces hunger bar to energy bar
body:
# ⚡ Energy Bar Resource Pack

Are you bored with the standard Minecraft hunger bar? You don't hate it, but you're looking for something a little different—something that feels **fresh** yet remains **logical** and **vanilla-friendly**.

Lucky for you, this resource pack does exactly that!

### 🛠️ What it does
This pack replaces the classic hunger bar textures with sleek, modern **Energy Bar** textures. It transforms your HUD while maintaining the core Minecraft aesthetic you love.
